verdict.rationale: Asaas is an API-first payments platform. Its REST API automates charges, payments and other operations and uses non-interactive API-key authentication in a header, which suits headless and CI automation. A dedicated Sandbox lets automated flows, including webhooks and simulated payments, be tested before using production credentials. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance or examples, an official CLI or SDK for scripted runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With the Asaas API, you can automate charges, receipts, and payments via Pix, bank slip (boleto), credit card, debit card, and TED.
The Asaas API uses an API key to identify the account responsible for the request. Send the key in the access_token header.
You can test flows such as creating customers, charges, payments, transfers, and Webhooks before using Production credentials.
Simulate the payment in the Sandbox. Receive the corresponding Webhook event.
